work.abstract_text: For Kimberling's conjecture in the second Comments line of OEIS A371279, revision 11, and A371280, revision 10, we prove that the prescribed ordered construction enumerates the rationals in (0,1] exactly once, by extending the denominator descent for the BMO–Kepler closure lemma in Saha (2025, Solution 14) and Grytczuk–Kisielewicz–Przesławski (2026, Theorem 6.2). For 1 <= p <= q, the fraction p/q belongs to the first q generations, whose minimum is 2^(1-q); a continued-fraction digit sum gives a further generation bound. We determine every position's multiplicity in the related array A371353, correcting its prime-occurrence assertion and displayed examples. We also give short proofs of the linked rational-closure results of Kimberling and Moses (2014).

work.title: Kimberling's rational-enumeration conjecture: an extension of the BMO–Kepler closure lemma
